verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence of multi-item action is that Ari can create several scenarios from one line (a hire wave, a slipped quarter, a downside case, 'several at once'), plus re-importing past months in one sync action. No general bulk-edit or batch operation over many Model items (tables, variables, formulas) is documented, whether in the UI or through the MCP tools. Missing for 10: documented bulk/batch edit of many Model items at once, batch operations via MCP tools, limits and behavior of multi-item changes, independent or hands-on corroboration.
